name: claude-anthropic
description: Anthropic Claude provider module: Messages-API model routing, system-message lifting, typed-output validation and cloud-to-local (Ollama) graceful degradation.

features.desc: Anthropic Messages API chat with model tiers and typed output validation. Provider-specific: the deepseek module's equivalent base chat capability is its own chat-completions feature, since the two providers speak different wire protocols (Messages API vs OpenAI-compatible chat/completions).

System messages lifted into the top-level system field of the Messages request. Provider-specific: this step has no deepseek counterpart because the OpenAI-compatible chat/completions shape already carries a native system role message, so there is nothing to lift.
Cloud-to-local fallback to the keyless local Ollama hop when the primary is unavailable.
LOW routes to claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, MED/HIGH to claude-sonnet-5, MAX to claude-opus-5, chosen from the issue-#9 tier ladder (parity with the deepseek module's tier-routing capability).

Marks the system prompt and trailing message content block cache_control:ephemeral so a stable prefix is eligible for Anthropic's prompt cache. Claude-specific improvement over the deepseek module; flag-gated OFF by default (GR-28) - enable per provider config via provider_options.prompt_caching.

Enables adaptive extended thinking (thinking:{type:adaptive}) at a chosen output_config.effort (low/medium/high/xhigh/max). Claude-specific improvement over the deepseek module; flag-gated OFF by default (GR-28) - enable per provider config via provider_options.thinking_effort.

provenance.note: Vendored as the claude/anthropic module-catalog entry (issue #255), closing the 4-of-5 gap left by issue #124 which covered DeepSeek, Ollama, Hermes and Paperclip. Pattern only; no source file copied.
